Bundle: CanDoItAll process template execution bundle — current architecture aligned

Tasks.Goal: Refresh the template-pack schema so it models role usages, dependencies, artifact inputs, branch coordinates, and shared/local resources explicitly.
Deliverables: Updated workbook tabs for dependencies and artifact inputs
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Must pass architecture review gate A before the next subbundle may begin.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a corrective subbundle focused on schema mismatches, then rerun gate A.

Tasks.Goal: Realign the seeded baseline scenarios to the current five-process repository expectations and current step keys.
Deliverables: Updated validation assertions for software, branching, and hotfix expectations
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Validator must confirm five expected baseline scenarios and exact key process expectations.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a corrective subbundle for baseline drift, then rerun validation.

Tasks.Goal: Revisit all processes and remove earlier simplifications that were only present because the older module lacked current features.
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Each process must have detailed roles, artifacts, checklists, validations, prompts, dependencies, and artifact inputs where relevant.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a process-specific corrective subbundle and do not continue until the process passes review.

Tasks.Goal: Ensure every template can export Mermaid flowchart and sequence diagrams plus supporting markdown sidecars.
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Mermaid exporter and supporting file inventory must cover definition docs and resource docs.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Create an exporter corrective subbundle and rerun architecture review gate B.

Tasks.Goal: Project current-module import envelopes from the pack and verify parity for dependencies, artifact inputs, and decision roles.
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Projection compatibility reports must show no blocking issues.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a projection corrective subbundle before continuing.

Tasks.Goal: Strengthen unit tests and validation scripts so future process-module changes surface pack regressions immediately.
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Test inventory must cover loader, projection, exporter, catalog, and current baseline expectations.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a test-gap corrective subbundle and rerun gate B.

Tasks.Goal: Stop after the early pack refresh and re-check schema fidelity before more implementation effort is spent.
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Must pass or produce a corrective subbundle.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Open a corrective subbundle immediately and prohibit downstream progress.

Tasks.Goal: Address the remaining hardcoded authoring chrome in ProcessCanvasSurfaceFactory so quick-create and group actions become file-driven.
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Either complete the de-hardcode patch or explicitly accept the debt in the final QA memo.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Escalate as architectural debt that must stay visible in the final bundle.

Tasks.Goal: Stop again after projection, Mermaid, and tests to catch wrong architectural direction before final closure.
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Must pass or produce another corrective subbundle.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Open a corrective subbundle before any final QA activity.

Tasks.Goal: Perform the strict final QA and senior architect inspection, then package the final ZIP only after all gates are satisfied.
Tasks.ProgressionGate: Final QA memo must state whether any debt remains and why it is or is not acceptable.
Tasks.CorrectiveOnFailure: Create one more corrective subbundle and repeat the final audit.
